en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Hakam who said,
‘Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Drinking the cold water is abundant enjoyment’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hisham ibn al-Hakam who has said the following:
“Abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Drinking cold water is more delicious.’”
